question: What happens to age and death by day through non-eating?
premises: divasāt nāśanena eva means by day through non-eating indeed
vayo mṛtyuṃ gamiṣyate means age and death will go
inference: By day, through non-eating, age and death will go away.
uncertainties: whether divasāt modifies non-eating or result
plain_english: By day, through non-eating, age and death will pass away.
